ops.comment: hover loop while Jetfire is talking

fra.text: Ouah... C'est quoi ce truc, Ratchet ?

int.text: Come on guys!  We're almost there!
Oh, GREAT. The speedway is out!
Heads up! We've got another Decepticon war machine, dead ahead!
Perfect! Then we can get back to the fight outside, right?
Ahhh, the elevator's busted! How do we get up there?
Oh no...was that Soundwave...? Optimus, that was SOUNDWAVE!
Awww YEAH! We've got it down, now! Bring on the rest of 'em!

fra.text: Ooooh, OUAIS ! On l'a eu ! On va toutes les démolir ! Toutes !

int.text: Just give me a clear shot.
Megatron can take this city over my twisted, lifeless shell!

fra.text: OUAIS ! Ils ont dû le sentir passer !

int.text: Guys!  Get out of there!  Now!
The Decepticons are really giving it all they've got here, aren't they?
Heads up! That Warship's coming in pretty hot!
Optimus! This is Ironhide.  There's a huge faction of Decepticons massing outside the Decagon's main gate!

fra.text: Optimus. Ici Ironhide. Un énorme contingent de Decepticons se rassemble devant l'entrée principale du Decagon.

int.text: Understood. And Optimus -- glad to see you've finally stepped up.

fra.text: Compris. Et Optimus... content de te voir enfin prendre les choses en main.

int.text: Yeah, well, just try not to get us all shot to pieces in the process.
Still working on clearing that path for you, Optimus.  These Decepticons are REALLY stubborn.  Be advised, I've got some Defenders near your position engaging some Decepticon war machines.
Thanks, Optimus! We appreciate the help!

fra.text: Merci, Optimus. On apprécie tous ton aide !

int.text: Optimus!  Your path is clear!  I'll move on and flank the Decepticons in the northern sector.

fra.text: Optimus ! La voie est libre ! Je vais contourner les Decepticons et les attaquer par le nord !

int.text: We got a Brute needs punchin'!
There's a Brute up ahead. Let's shoot it.

fra.text: Il aurait mieux fait de rester chez lui.

int.text: Whoops. We'll coordinate better next time.
You shouldn't get that close to explosives, y'know.

fra.text: Tu devrais reculer quand tu vois des explosifs, tu sais ?

int.text: Careful, now! I'd prefer you in one piece!

fra.text: Fais attention, ou tu vas finir en morceaux !

int.text: They fly apart real nice, don't they?

fra.text: Ils explosent vraiment bien, pas vrai ?

int.text: That's what you get for pickin' the wrong side.

fra.text: Voilà ce qui arrive quand on choisit le mauvais camp.

int.text: Hurry up! I'm not gonna stand here like this all day!
To any Autobots on this frequency...this is Jetfire. Come in.
We're taking heavy damage up here! Put me through to Zeta Prime -- we need him to activate the planetary guns.
Optimus! Inbound Decepticon Seekers! I think you can take them out with the gun emplacements!
Nice shooting Optimus.  Air Raid and I have control of the skies now.
From the sky they look barely usable, but you can try.  Good luck, Optimus.  With Zeta Prime gone we are all looking to you now.
Optimus, this is Jetfire. Do you copy?
You've got a squadron of Decepticon Seekers headed your way! I couldn't stop them all...!
Optimus, be advised! Starscream is headed your way! We tried to stop them, but Silverbolt and I sustained heavy damage.
He's DEAD?  ...What're we going to DO...?
Citizens of Iacon!  I, Megatron, have destroyed your unworthy leader, Zeta Prime.  Now you have the privilege of experiencing MY rule.  I shall not be denied!
Jetfire, this is Optimus. Glad you're still airborne. What's your status?
Understood, Jetfire. Autobots! Man the turrets!
Focus fire on that ship Autobots
Thanks, Jetfire. We need to get to the Decagon fast. Are the Iacon speedways still drivable?
Remember Autobots!  Blast the spikes, but never touch them!  Transform and ROLL OUT!
All the more reason to reach it quickly!
Autobots -- lock and load. Taking back the Decagon won't be easy.
You've got the schematics, Ratchet. Lead the way.
You have committed crimes against Iacon, Starscream! It's time to pay for them!

fra.text: Tu as trop longtemps trahi Iacon, Starscream ! L'heure est venue de payer pour tes crimes !

int.text: I...cannot believe Zeta Prime is gone. I always knew Megatron was dangerous...but this--?
Good job.  The grid is back online.  Let's get to the broadcast room up top so we can re-connect Iacon's defenses.

fra.text: Beau travail ! La grille est opérationnelle. Maintenant, on peut réactiver les défenses de Iacon depuis la salle des transmissions.

int.text: Let's do it...then we can strike back at the Decepticons in full force.
Take out as many as you can. I need a pathway cleared!
That's the spirit, Bumblebee.  Autobots -- to the Decagon!
Get clear, Jetfire. You've done more than enough already.
Autobots -- exercise caution. Starscream is as dangerous as he is treacherous.
Not destroyed, Ratchet. Simply taken. He knows we are at our weakest with Zeta Prime gone.
Focus on the task at hand, Autobots.

fra.text: Jetfire... Zeta Prime a été détruit.

int.text: I have assumed temporary command, Jetfire. Let the rest of your flight squadrons know. And don't worry--we'll get those guns on-line.
Don't let up, Autobots! Keep going--for Zeta Prime!
The High Council of Elders will choose the next Prime. ...I'm merely a stand-in until that choice is made.
There -- the controls for the planetary guns! Activate them now!
This is far from over, Bumblebee.  The skies might be clear, but our ground forces are in disarray.
I'll do my best. Autobots Roll out.
Just doing what needs to be done, Ironhide.

fra.text: Je fais simplement ce que j'ai à faire, Ironhide.

int.text: The communication grid is in the Decagon.  If we get there in time--we've got a chance.
There was nothing we could do, Bumblebee.

fra.text: Nous ne pouvions rien pour eux, Bumblebee.

int.text: Not now, Ratchet--Jetfire needs those guns online.
You have my thanks, old friend. Good hunting!

fra.text: Encore merci, mon vieil ami. Et bonne chance !

int.text: I've seen these in the archives.  They're used to dispense Dark Energon.
Dark Energon is the source of these crystals.  I've read the stories--but to see it for real.
Megatron has somehow found a way to weaponize Dark Energon.
It's causing a subatomic displacement on a scale I've never seen before -- it's corrupting Energon at an alarming rate!
We're going to have ride the turbines to reach the other side!

fra.text: Nous allons devoir grimper sur les turbines pour atteindre l'autre côté !

int.text: Fight to the top of the stairs!
Optimus, the Communication Grid is located at the top of the Decagon. We need to find a lift up.
The elevator's wrecked! We'll need to find another way up.

fra.text: Hors service ! Il va falloir qu'on trouve une autre solution.

int.text: There -- that's the main terminal for the communication grid. We can reactivate it by aligning the data streams. ...I think, in theory anyway.
We have to get out of these tubes NOW!

fra.text: Il faut qu'on sorte de là TOUT DE SUITE !

int.text: We've got to get back to the speedway!

fra.text: Il faut qu'on retourne sur la voie rapide !

int.text: Aim for the chest! AIM FOR THE CHEST!
It's working! Taking out the source makes the roots retract! Now Iacon can start repairing itself!
That they are. All Autobot communications funnel through the Decagon hub.  It's the lifeline for the entire city.
The service lift is over there! MOVE!
According to the schematics, the broadcast control room will be at the top of the lift.
Hmmm.  We could ride the energon shell capacitors instead.  Might take a little longer--but it should work!
The automated repair systems are still functional, at least. That's a good sign.
That's odd...Optimus, I'm picking up a concentration of electro-tetronic anomalies close by.

fra.text: Étrange... Optimus, je détecte une forte concentration d'anomalies électro-tétroniques à proximité.

int.text: Megatron is determined, I'll give him that. He means to see Iacon destroyed!
We'd prefer no further loss of life, Bumblebee.

fra.text: Cette guerre a déjà fait assez de victimes, Bumblebee...

int.text: Not bad for a  temporary command,  Optimus. You're better at this than you give yourself credit for.
Bumblebee...it wouldn't KILL you to exercise caution.
Optimus, if we can get the communication grid back online, we'll be able to coordinate our defenses.

fra.text: Optimus, nous devons rétablir les communications... C'est le seul moyen de coordonner nos défenses.

int.text: I'm reading a massive surge of--
We'll need to activate the planetary guns--here.
This will be the fate of all Autobots if we don't hurry.
Look out.  That's a Decepticon Warship!

fra.text: Attention ! Un vaisseau de guerre Decepticon !

int.text: That's not it. The data streams have to align with the sockets.
Dark Energon?  I thought that was the stuff of legend!
Autobot signatures detected in the eastern access highway.
Activate thermal detonation probes. Target: Iacon Highway

fra.text: Activation des charges thermiques. Cible : voies rapides de Iacon.

int.text: Trying to restore your precious Grid, Autobots...? How pathetic.
Oh, I think not...'Optimus,' is it?  Prepare to die!
You're no match for the speed and power of STARSCREAM!
A lucky shot!  Now you've made me angry!
ARRRGH! You'll see me again, Autobots! That's a PROMISE!
